changes.text: Talos electrician wire-nut sample: added. One free 62 s episode of an electrician joining ceiling-light wires, recorded with a right-hand Talos glove (10 FSR pads at 200 Hz with bench-estimated newtons, 12 IMUs giving a 21-joint hand pose) and a head-mounted OAK-D Pro W; CC BY-NC 4.0; the full 26-minute job is sold through Datarade.

MTS-3DCNNs: added. Frontiers in Neurorobotics 2023 object classifier with gradient adaptive frame sampling and three temporal-scale 3D CNN branches; 88.81% top-1 on the 27 MIT-STAG glove classes and 100% on iCub hand data; no code linked.
